d.tr: Did you see the open show?
d.ctx: The expert asks if the user has seen the open show. The user replies that he hasn't seen it and asks if she will show it.
d.j: The expert is asking about an 'open show', which is a term for sexual content.

d.seg: मैं इसलिए पूछा ना कि इस पे लोग देखने ही आते हैं
d.tr: I asked because people only come here to watch this.
d.ctx: The expert explains that people come to the app to watch sexual content. The user asks her to show it.
d.j: The expert is confirming that the purpose of the app is to watch sexual content.

d.seg: इस पे लोग देखने ही आते हैं बोलते हैं दिखाओ
d.tr: People come here to watch, they say 'show me'.
d.ctx: The expert repeats that people come to watch and ask to be shown sexual content. The user asks her to show it.
d.j: The expert is confirming that people ask to be shown sexual content.

d.seg: तो देख देखो डियर दिखा तो दूंगी बट मुझे क्या मिलेगा ये बताओ
d.tr: So look dear, I will show you, but tell me what will I get?
d.ctx: The expert agrees to show the content but asks what she will get in return. The user asks what she wants.
d.j: The expert is asking for payment in exchange for showing sexual content.

d.seg: मैं इस पे तो दिखाऊंगी क्यों नहीं दिखाऊंगी
d.tr: I will show it on this, why wouldn't I show it?
d.ctx: The expert says she will show it on the app but prefers WhatsApp because the app blurs the video.
d.j: The expert is offering to show sexual content.

d.tr: But you will have to do it on WhatsApp.
d.ctx: The expert says she will show the content but insists on moving to WhatsApp. The user agrees to pay.
d.j: The expert is proposing to move the conversation to WhatsApp.

d.seg: मैं आपको इस पे भी दिखा दे रही हूं WhatsApp पे भी दिखा दूंगी
d.tr: I am showing you on this, I will also show you on WhatsApp.
d.ctx: The expert offers to show the content on both the app and WhatsApp. The user asks about the quality.
d.j: The expert is proposing to move the conversation to WhatsApp.

d.seg: अब तो आ जाओ WhatsApp पे ये क्लियर हो गया ना मैं दिखाती हूं
d.tr: Now come to WhatsApp, it's clear now, I will show you.
d.ctx: The expert asks the user to come to WhatsApp to see the content. The user asks how much money she wants.
d.j: The expert is proposing to move the conversation to WhatsApp.

d.seg: ऐसा तो देखो मैं 1000 लेती हूं तुम बताओ कितना दोगे
d.tr: See, I take 1000, you tell me how much you will give.
d.ctx: The expert states her price for showing the content. The user offers 200.
d.j: The expert is asking for a specific amount of money for showing sexual content.

d.seg: 500 में ओपन शो का लेती हूं और कपल सेक्स लाइफ सेक्स का 1000 लेती हूं
d.tr: I take 500 for an open show and 1000 for couple sex or live sex.
d.ctx: The expert explains her rates for different types of sexual content.
d.j: The expert is stating her rates for sexual services.
